metadata.question: Was the mean aerosol optical depth higher over Chengdu than over Suining between 2001 and 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MAIAC AOD (MODIS/006/MCD19A2) from 2001-01-01 to 2023-12-31 over buffered points representing Chengdu (30.5728N, 104.0668E) and Suining (30.5333N, 105.5333E), with 25 km buffers.
2. Masking strategy: Mask to high-quality MAIAC AOD using AOD_QA bits (0–1 <= 1), apply scale factor 0.001, and keep values 0–5. No separate cloud mask needed.
3. Logic: Check collection size (C1), valid pixel counts from the time-mean image (C2), verify mean values are finite and within [0,5] (C3). Compare Chengdu vs Suining to output A or B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const start = '2001-01-01';
  const end = '2023-12-31';
  const chengdu = ee.Geometry.Point([104.0668, 30.5728]).buffer(25000);
  const suining = ee.Geometry.Point([105.5333, 30.5333]).buffer(25000);

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
  const col0 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2')
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filterBounds(chengdu.union(suining, 1));

  const colSize = await col0.size().getInfo();
  if (!colSize || colSize === 0) {
    console.log(`Dataset: MODIS/006/MCD19A2, Period: ${start}..${end}`);
    console.log('Images: 0');
    console.log('No images found in date/location.');
    console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
    return;
  }

  // 3. Processing: mask to good QA, scale, and valid range
  function maskMCD19A2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('AOD_QA');
    const qaBits01 = qa.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1
    const good = qaBits01.lte(1);
    const aod = img.select('Optical_Depth_055').multiply(0.001);
    const valid = aod.gte(0).and(aod.lte(5));
    return aod.updateMask(good).updateMask(valid).rename('AOD055').copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
  }

  const col = col0.map(maskMCD19A2);
  const meanImg = col.mean(); // time-mean AOD per pixel
  const bandName = 'AOD055';

  // Helper to compute stats for an AOI
  async function statsForAOI(geom) {
    const totalPix = await ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 3000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('one').getInfo();

    const validPix = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 3000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get(bandName).getInfo();

    if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
      return { mean: null, validPix: 0, totalPix: totalPix || 0, validPct: 0 };
    }

    const meanVal = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 3000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get(bandName).getInfo();

    const validPct = totalPix && totalPix > 0 ? (validPix / totalPix) * 100.0 : 0;
    return { mean: meanVal, validPix, totalPix: totalPix || 0, validPct };
  }

  const ch = await statsForAOI(chengdu);
  const su = await statsForAOI(suining);

  console.log(`Dataset: MODIS/006/MCD19A2 (MAIAC), Band: Optical_Depth_055, Period: ${start}..${end}`);
  console.log(`Images: ${colSize}`);

  // 4. Validation (C2/C3)
  if ((ch.validPix === 0) || (su.validPix === 0)) {
    console.log(`Chengdu valid pixels: ${ch.validPix}/${ch.totalPix} (${ch.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Suining valid pixels: ${su.validPix}/${su.totalPix} (${su.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
    return;
  }

  const invalidCh = (ch.mean === null || isNaN(ch.mean) || ch.mean < 0 || ch.mean > 5);
  const invalidSu = (su.mean === null || isNaN(su.mean) || su.mean < 0 || su.mean > 5);
  if (invalidCh || invalidSu) {
    console.log(`Chengdu mean AOD: ${ch.mean}, valid: ${!invalidCh}`);
    console.log(`Suining mean AOD: ${su.mean}, valid: ${!invalidSu}`);
    console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is `None`, `NaN`, or invalid).');
    return;
  }

  // 5. Results and Final Answer
  console.log(`Chengdu mean AOD: ${ch.mean.toFixed(3)}, validPix: ${ch.validPix}/${ch.totalPix} (${ch.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
  console.log(`Suining mean AOD: ${su.mean.toFixed(3)}, validPix: ${su.validPix}/${su.totalPix} (${su.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
  const answer = ch.mean > su.mean ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
  console.log(answer);
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
